claims.subject_mention: early seizure onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
claims.object_mention: Biophysical gain of function in SCN2A
claims.quote: Biophysical gain of function in SCN2A is seen in some patients with early seizure onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE).
Antisense oligonucleotide therapy reduces seizures and extends life span in an SCN2A gain-of-function epilepsy model.
We tested this theory by central administration of a gapmer antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) targeting Scn2a mRNA in a mouse model of Scn2a early seizure onset DEE (Q/+ mice).
A human SCN2A gapmer ASO could likewise impact the lives of patients with SCN2A gain-of-function DEE.
